app.intro: Import some videos, choose the configuration and then press Start to speed up (or remove) their silences.

file.remove: Remove this video from the list
help.backgroundNoise: How loud the room is. Raise it when a quiet hiss is being mistaken for speech.
help.crf: Constant Rate Factor: lower means better quality and a bigger file. 23 is a good default.
help.ffmpegNotice: FFmpeg is bundled with this app under the GPLv3 licence. There is nothing to install or configure.
help.format: Container for the exported file. Keep reuses the source container.
help.fps: Frame rate every fragment is normalised to, so the pieces can be joined without re-encoding.

help.intro: Speed up your videos by speeding up (or removing) silences, using FFmpeg. Built with Flutter.
help.license: This program comes with absolutely no warranty. It is free software, and you are welcome to redistribute it under certain conditions; see the licence for details.
help.muteSilences: Silence the audio of the quiet parts instead of letting the sped-up hiss through.
help.playbackSpeed: Rate for the parts where someone is speaking. Leave at 1x to keep speech natural.
help.preset: How hard x264 works. Slower presets give smaller files for the same quality.
help.silenceMargin: Time kept on each side of every silence, so words are not clipped.
help.silenceMinDuration: How long a pause must last before it counts as silence.
help.silenceSpeed: Rate for the quiet parts. Pick Remove to cut them out entirely.
log.alreadyExists: Cannot load {{name}}: that file name is already queued.
log.dataError: Data error: silence boundaries do not pair up.
log.fileMissing: {{name}} is no longer where it was; skipping it.
log.noSilenceDetected: No silences detected, moving on to the next.
log.silencePercentage: {{percentage}} % of the video detected as silence.
log.skipNoSilences: Analysis failed, moving on to the next.
preference.bundledFfmpeg: FFmpeg is bundled with the app: there is no path to configure.
